_comment: Config for `pcat.py plan`. Copy to _Catalog\reorg_config.json and fill in from the intake interview. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_homes_example_note: These homes are placeholders. Replace each label, date range (from/to) and lat/lon with the places you actually lived or worked.
_homes_note: Overlapping periods are fine (a day is 'home' if it is inside ANY active home). Add temporary residences and regular work cities so they don't become dozens of tiny trips.
_trusted_note: Date sources plan() treats as real dates. 'sequence' = date-seq, 'manual' = set-dates.
_library_catalog_note: Only for imports from another drive: path to the Library's catalog.jsonl so new files join existing event folders.
_geonames_note: Leave empty to auto-use _Catalog\cities15000.txt (download with `pcat.py geonames --dir <_Catalog>`).
